name: ZIT - ARTManiac
description: ZIT - ARTManiac A powerhouse illustration LoRA for Z-Image-Turbo that delivers stunning, hand-drawn results. It's self-sufficient and works like a charm at 0.85 strength, but also plays nicely with other LoRAs. Just prompt and paint. No trigger word needed. The model works great with other LoRAs as a base — if you set the model strength to 0.5 + your LoRA or LoRAs, the results will be excellent (in most cases)
